correctness.rationale: All directed relations, including dead ends, loops and cycles, are allowed. The bad-set recurrence is exact, monotonicity justifies finite ranks, and induction proves a rank-t first-failure vertex has an infinite-rank successor with maximum outgoing finite rank t-1. These witnesses give 2t mutually distinct vertices forming a directed simple path to a dead end, so first failure at t requires at least 2t worlds. Path frames achieve equality, and absence of rank beyond floor(n/2) gives stabilization. Standalone checker verified 66,066 exhaustive frames on n<=4, 10,000 sampled frames n=5..8, and t<=30 path families.

value.rationale: A single natural sequence of modal approximants now has an exact all-size stabilization index and exact minimum distinguishing frame size at every depth, with a forced simple-path certificate. It extends isolated solver-certified cases to an analytic universal theorem and improves the generic finite monotone-iteration bound by a factor near two. It does not rely on unmotivated parameter slicing or only computational novelty.
